name: Grafana Beyla Open-Source eBPF Instrumentation
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Linux eBPF auto-instrumentation for HTTP/gRPC and other supported application traffic, exporting OpenTelemetry traces and Prometheus metrics; no Beyla software license fee or vendor-imposed self-hosted usage quota.
watch_out: Requires Linux kernel/eBPF/BTF support and elevated tracing capabilities; operator must supply compute, storage, telemetry backend and security controls. Grafana Cloud and hosted observability usage may incur charges. Beyla code is migrating toward upstream OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation; avoid cataloguing that upstream as a separate equivalent offering.
